checks.describe: pytest only discovers functions named test_* (not plain functions)
checks.run: python3 -c "import subprocess; r=subprocess.run(['uv','run','pytest','--collect-only','-q'],cwd='labs/checkpoints/v0.10',capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15); items=[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if '::test_' in l]; print('discovered' if len(items)>10 else 'too-few')"

checks.describe: a conftest.py exists in the test directory (shared fixtures)
checks.run: ls labs/checkpoints/v0.10/tests/conftest.py 2>/dev/null && echo exists || echo missing

checks.describe: pytest assertion rewriting shows actual vs expected on failure
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.10 && uv run python3 -c "import pytest; pytest.main(['-x','--tb=short','-q','--co'])" 2>&1 | head -1; echo ok

checks.describe: pytest-cov is available in the project's dev dependencies
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.10 && uv run pytest --co -p no:cacheprovider --cov=platformops -q 2>&1 | tail -1; echo done

checks.describe: parametrize is used in test_servicedef.py (proof of the lesson's concept in real code)
the test suite uses monkeypatch more than unittest.mock.patch (lesson recommendation)
checks.run: bash -c "mp=$(grep -rl 'monkeypatch' labs/checkpoints/v0.10/tests/*.py 2>/dev/null | wc -l); up=$(grep -rl 'mock.patch' labs/checkpoints/v0.10/tests/*.py 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo mp=$mp up=$up; [ $mp -ge $up ] && echo preferred || echo not-preferred"

checks.describe: fixtures without an explicit scope default to function-level (no leftover state between tests)
checks.run: python3 -c "import ast; t=open('labs/checkpoints/v0.10/tests/test_local_ops.py').read(); tree=ast.parse(t); fixtures=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and any(isinstance(d,ast.Name) and d.id=='fixture' or isinstance(d,ast.Attribute) and d.attr=='fixture' for d in n.decorator_list if hasattr(n,'decorator_list'))]; print(len(fixtures),'fixtures found')"
